questions.title: Create an nginx pod with a liveness probe that just runs...
questions.body: Create an nginx pod with a liveness probe that just runs the command 'ls'. Save its YAML in pod.yaml. Run it, check its probe status, delete it.

questions.title: Modify the pod.yaml file so that liveness probe starts...
questions.body: Modify the pod.yaml file so that liveness probe starts kicking in after 5 seconds whereas the interval between probes would be 5 seconds. Run it, check the probe, delete it.

questions.title: Create an nginx pod (that includes port 80) with an HTTP...
questions.body: Create an nginx pod (that includes port 80) with an HTTP readinessProbe on path '/' on port 80. Again, run it, check the readinessProbe, delete it.

questions.title: Lots of pods are running in `qa`,`alan`,`test`,`productio...
questions.body: Lots of pods are running in `qa`,`alan`,`test`,`production` namespaces.  All of these pods are configured with liveness probe.  Please list all pods whose liveness probe are failed in the format of `<namespace>/<pod name>` per line.

questions.title: Create a busybox pod that runs `i=0; while true; do echo...
questions.body: Create a busybox pod that runs `i=0; while true; do echo "$i: $(date)"; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done`. Check its logs

questions.title: Create a busybox pod that runs 'ls /notexist'. Determine...
questions.body: Create a busybox pod that runs 'ls /notexist'. Determine if there's an error (of course there is), see it. In the end, delete the pod

questions.title: Create a busybox pod that runs 'notexist'. Determine if...
questions.body: Create a busybox pod that runs 'notexist'. Determine if there's an error (of course there is), see it. In the end, delete the pod forcefully with a 0 grace period
